author: berkdai
quote: Locking Grand Theft Auto VI at 30 FPS on launch is unacceptable. Sony's underpowered console hardware holds the game back, while Rockstar greedily delays the PC version just to double-dip on sales. PC hardware can easily run this at smooth frame rates right now, yet players are forced into a choppy, outdated 30 FPS experience. Total disrespect to gamers.
